description: Depot's kinds (docs/apps/depot.md): a FILE and a DEPOT_DROPBOX, each at the root or in a folder and taking no placed child. A file roots a READ or READ_WRITE link and a folder link's contributor creates one; a drop box carries a cover, needs the drop-box links to be created, roots a WRITE_ONLY link only, and its guests create files in their own identity folders (ADR 0080 decision 11). A guest never creates a drop box (owner 2026-10-14).
